name: Diethylstilbestrol Diphosphate
summary: The drug Diethylstilbestrol Diphosphate does not have any listed warning signs, FDA reports, or human trial records in the provided data [1][2]. Its liver and heart scores come from a small computer model rather than tests on people [M]. The computer model placed both the liver score of 44 and the heart score of 28 into the low category [M].
